acs.notes: Income, rent, and home value in 2025 dollars. Income and housing medians are survey estimates with 90% margins of error. Homeownership is owner-occupied / occupied housing units; a derived rate, not a separately published estimate. History uses each reporting year’s dollars, not inflation-adjusted change. Differences have not been tested for statistical significance. Standard 2020 ACS 1-year estimates are excluded.

bea.notes: GDP is current-dollar annual GDP. Real growth is calculated from annual real GDP in chained 2017 dollars. Previously published estimates may be revised.

bls.notes: Monthly seasonally adjusted unemployment rate. Latest observations may be preliminary and subject to revision.
